title: durian-ripeness-audit: reproducible audit package (v1.9.0) for fruit-grouped and batch-aware evaluation of thermal, multispectral, knocking-sound and RGB durian ripeness classification
description: Code, frozen fruit partitions, session labels with the rule applied, recording exclusions with evidence, raw-archive inventory, feature tables, out-of-fold predictions, fitted models, model registry with hyper-parameter searches, Supplementary Tables S1-S22 and verified commands reproducing every table of the paper from cached predictions, cached features or the raw Zenodo dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.18603796). Derived tables: CC BY 4.0 with attribution to the dataset authors.
